# ex: implicit * in non-selector context (applySubst implicit deref)
ex {
	var t T
	t.X -> F(t)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(t T) int { return t.X }

func G(p *T) int {
	return p.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 func F(t T) int { return t.X }

 func G(p *T) int {
-	return p.X
+	return F(*p)
 }
